integrity: The analytical proof gives finite Gaussian conditioning, deterministic Hausdorff continuity, limit classification and the sharp converse; finite exact-rational checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only zero-valued exact simultaneous second differences of standard Brownian motion on a deterministic uniform grid; weak C[0,1] convergence and Hausdorff subsequences. Historical equivalence to general Gaussian interpolation literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Closed-set limits and the sharp cluster criterion for Brownian second-difference conditioning
